scope: Synthetic iPhone camera stream in desktop WebKit; API and MediaRecorder are mocked. Not a physical iPhone result.
test: muted rear preview holds the last frame until a real frame, then saves one take

baseline.observed: Rear stream was live, muted, loaded, and had nonzero video dimensions; #cam-hold had been hidden while the stream was still black.

patched_local.observed: Recorder canvas top pixel stayed red during 300 ms of black muted rear frames, then changed to lime after unmute; held preview stayed visible until the real rear frame, and one take was accepted.

latest_rerun.result: PASS 1/1 in focused combined WebKit run; stop-while-muted case also PASS 1/1
